_README: F5 completeness attestation. The pipeline cannot know English phonotactics, so it cannot
decide on its own whether a submitted onset table is complete. What it CAN do is verify that
the transcription matches what the person who read the reference says the reference contains.
That is the completeness check: you declare the counts the named source gives, and the
importer refuses to mark F5 POPULATED unless the submitted table matches them exactly.
No expected inventory and no expected count is hard-coded anywhere in this repository.
Until approved_by_spec_owner is true and the declared counts match, F5 stays UNPOPULATED.
dialect_note: Must be General American: the lexicon is CMUdict (Section 9). An SSBE inventory lists /spj stj skj/, which General American largely lacks through yod-dropping, and would admit onsets CMUdict never produces.
